exposure.needed: which backend responses are served without a Content-Type header at runtime, and which routers lack the ContentType middleware

consequence.statement: Responses whose backend does not set a Content-Type header are served without an auto-detected Content-Type value, so clients may interpret them differently than under v2 unless the ContentType middleware is attached.
consequence.remediation: Attach the ContentType middleware to routers whose backends do not set the Content-Type header, to re-enable Content-Type auto-detection.

assertion.statement: In Traefik v3 the Content-Type header is no longer auto-detected when the backend does not set it; the ContentType middleware must be used to re-enable Content-Type auto-detection.
